_comment: REAL-LLM (spends money) — end-to-end flat reason-act loop with a real provider. No scripted_model_responses, so ClassifyRequest classifies for real (a clearly-Deliberate task), RoutingWorkflow stages real memory/skill/tool retrieval under the turn id, prompt.assemble builds a real prompt, and the turn runs a real multi-iteration ModelCall loop to completion. At turn end dispatchRecordSkill fires over the trajectory. Run manually: run_scenario.sh real-llm-pipeline.
